member.name: T:AtomUI.Labs.Controls.ImageGallery.Layout.ImageGalleryToolbarPanel
member.summary: Lays out toolbar roles sequentially while forcing every role onto the same cross-axis center line. StackPanel deliberately does not provide that guarantee for children with different desired sizes.

member.name: T:AtomUI.Labs.Controls.ImageGallery.Loading.ImageGalleryLoadScheduler
